portedFromTheOracle.rule: src/game-loop.js updateDiving(), Issue #27: under an overhead, all cylinders' gasRemaining on entering is the plan; more than THIRDS_TURN_FRACTION (2/3) left is outbound, more than THIRDS_RESERVE_FRACTION (1/3) the turn (thirdsTurnWarned, the beep), the rest the reserve (thirdsReserveHitThisDive, latched for the dive, which gradeDive() reads). Out from under it, the plan and the turn latch clear.
portedFromTheOracle.order: Legacy runs it after updateCNS() and updateOverheadState(), before the tick's gas consumption. The model runs it after accumulateCns and before updateLifeSupport, on DiveEnvironment.inOverhead (false when absent; advanceWithBuoyancy takes it per frame).
portedFromTheOracle.save: Save v13 carries the plan and both latches. Older saves resume with no plan and the reserve not reached; legacy saves keep thirdsReserveHitThisDive and, like legacy's restore, no plan.

fixtureRegeneration.legacyChange: captureBaselineCheckpoint() gains state.debrief.inOverhead, thirdsStartingGas_l, thirdsTurnWarned and thirdsReserveHit, and state.grade (gradeDive()'s scores, notes, overall and stars, for slice 6b). A new scenario, wreck-thirds, holds 32 m inside the wreck (x 50 m, under the main deck) on one 12 L cylinder of 21/35 through the outbound, turn and reserve thirds, then leaves the overhead.
fixtureRegeneration.additiveCheck: Every scenario on main is identical once the new fields are removed; wreck-thirds is added; the header differs only in referenceCommit. Regenerated after each rebase, identical each time apart from referenceCommit.
fixtureRegeneration.geometryException: wreck-thirds is the one scenario simulated against its declared site, since legacy finds an overhead from the site's geometry. docs/baseline/README.md records the exception, and tests/baseline.spec.js checks that every tick stays at the pinned 32 m and nothing is logged.

parity: wreck-thirds replayed tick by tick through advanceDiveStep with its own cylinder, under the overhead exactly when its checkpoint is: the plan (within 1e-6 L), the turn latch, the reserve latch and the gas left match legacy at every checkpoint. A replay resumed through the adapter from turn-20min continues legacy's plan.
